questions.question: If 25 October 2004 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 2 November 2007?
questions.solution:
Given: **25 October 2004** was Monday.

Now,

2004 to 2007 = 3 Years (3 Ordinary Years).

And, 3 Ordinary Years have 3 odd days.

then, 25 October 2007 will be Monday + 3 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 25 October 2007 to 2 November 2007

= 6 days (October) + 2 days (November) = 8 days.

= 8 days → 8/7 = 1 week and 1 odd days.

So, **2 November 2007** will be Thursday + 1 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 26 January 2019 was Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2022?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

i) In any two consecutive ordinary years, date of the next year will be one day ahead of the same day in the previous year.

ii) And** if a leap year** comes immediately after an ordinary year, then the day on a certain date of leap year will

(1)** 1 day ahead** of the same day of the ordinary year **upto February**,

(2)** 2 days ahead** of the same day of the ordinary year from** March to December**.

Therefore,

26 January 2019 = **Saturday**

26 January 2020 = **Sunday **

26 January 2021 = **Tuesday**

26 January 2022 =** Wednesday**

From 26 January to 30 January 2022

30 - 26 = 4 days 

**4 days after Wednesday is Sunday**

Hence, the correct answer is** Sunday.**

questions.question: If 15 January 2019 was a Tuesday, then what day of the week was it on 29 January 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: **15 January 2019** was Tuesday.

Now,

2019 to 2020 = 1 Year (1 Ordinary Year).

And, In 1 Year = 1 Ordinary Year.

then, 15 January 2020 will be Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday.

Now, the number of days between 15 January 2020 to 29 January 2020

= 14 days.

= 14 days → 14/7 = 2 weeks and 0 odd day.

So, **29 January 2020** will be Wednesday .

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: If 17 August 2003 was a Sunday, then what was the day of the week on 12 September 2014?
questions.solution:
Given: **17 August 2003** was Sunday.

Now,

2003 to 2014 = 11 Years (8 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 11 Years = 3 Leap years and 8 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 8 Ordinary Years have 8 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 8 = 14.

14 odd days → 14/7 = 2 weeks and 0 odd days.

then, 17 August 2014 will be Sunday + 0 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 17 August 2014 to 12 September 2014

= 14(August) + 12(September) = 26 days.

= 26 days → 26/7 = 3 weeks and 5 odd days.

So, **12 September 2014** will be Sunday + 5 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: If 29 November 2009 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 30 May 2010?
questions.solution:
There are 2 odd days in a month with 30 days and 3 odd days in a month with 31 days. Also, February with 28 days has 0 odd days and February with 29 days have 1 odd day.

Number of odd days between 29 November 2009 to 30 May 2010 = (1 + 3 + 3 + 0 + 3 + 2 + 30) = 42

42 when divided by 7, leaves 0 as remainder.

Sunday + 0 = Sunday

Hence, ‘**Sunday**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 1 January 2020 was a Wednesday, then what day of the week was it on 1 January 2021?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: A normal year advances the day of the year by 1 day. And a leap year advances the day of the year by 2 days. 

If 1 January 2020 was a Wednesday. We know 2020 is a leap year.

So, the day advances as shown below:

1 January 2021 → Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Friday"**.

questions.question: If exactly 1 year and 2 days later it is Tuesday, then what day is it today? It is not a leap year.
questions.solution:

Normal year = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day

As per the question:

1 year and 2 days later is Tuesday, which means the last day of the year is Saturday.

In a normal year first and last days are the same means** today is also Saturday.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question: If 29th September 2015 was a Tuesday, then what was the day of the week on 28th September 2019?
questions.solution:
**Given : 29th September 2015 was a Tuesday**

 
• Total number of days in a normal year = 365
 
• Total number of days in a leap year = 366
 
• Total number of odd days in a normal year = 365/7 = 1 
 
• Total number of odd days in a leap year = 366/7 = 2
 
• 29th September 2015 (Tuesday) + 2(2016) + 1(2017) + 1(2018) + 1(2019) = 29th September 2019 (Sunday)
 
• Thus, 29th September 2019 (Sunday) - 1 = **28th September 2019** (**Saturday**)

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If it will be Tuesday tomorrow, then what day of the week will it be 100 days from today?
questions.solution:

Tomorrow = Tuesday

Today = Monday

100 days from today:

⇒ (100 ÷ 7) = 14 weeks (Monday) + 2 days (Tuesday, **Wednesday**)

⇒ The 100th day will be **Wednesday.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question: In a month of 29 days, the second Thursday falls on the 13th day of the month. What day of the week will be the second last day of the month?
questions.solution:

So, second last day of the month means 28th February,

And, days between 13th February to 28th February - 15 days.

And, 15 days = 15/7 = 2 week and **1 odd day**.

Then, the second last day of the month will be: Thursday + 1 = **Friday**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: If 18 September 1998 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 September 2009?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 18 September 1998 is Friday, then the days on these dates will be:

18 September 1999 → Saturday

18 September 2000 → Monday

18 September 2001 → Tuesday

18 September 2002 → Wednesday

18 September 2003 → Thursday

18 September 2004 → Saturday

18 September 2005 → Sunday

18 September 2006 → Monday

18 September 2007 → Tuesday

18 September 2008 → Thursday

18 September 2009 → Friday

Number of days between 15 September 2009 and 18 September 2009 = 3

Friday - 3 = Tuesday

Clearly, it was Tuesday on 15 September 2009.

Hence, '**Tuesday**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 11 August 1918 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 4 December 1925?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 11 August 1918 is Sunday, then the day on these dates will be:

11 August 1919 → Monday

11 August 1920 → Wednesday

11 August 1921 → Thursday

11 August 1922 → Friday

11 August 1923 → Saturday

11 August 1924 → Monday

11 August 1925 → Tuesday

Number of days between 11 August 1925 to 4 December 1925 = (20 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 4) = 115

115 when divided by 7, leaves 3 as remainder.

Tuesday + 3 = Friday

Therefore, it will be Friday on 4 December 1925.

Hence, ‘**Friday**’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Given: 11 August 1918 is Sunday.

So, 11 August 1918 to 11 August 1925 = 7 Years (5 Ordinary and 2 leap Year)

In 7 years = (5 × 1) + (2 × 2) = 5 + 4 = 9 days.

And, from 11 August 1925 to 4 December 1925 = 20(Aug) + 30(Sept) + 31(Oct) + 30(Nov) + 4(Dec) = 115 days

Total days = 9 + 115 = 124 days → 124/7 = 17 week and 5 odd days.

So, 4 December 1925 = Sunday + 5 + Friday.

Hence. the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
